Home Décor Sapphire Peacock Crystal Sculpture (H-31CM)

Bring the splendor of nature into your space with this exquisite Sapphire Peacock Crystal Sculpture. Crafted with precision, this piece showcases a majestic peacock perched gracefully with its long, elegant tail cascading downwards. The stunning blend of sapphire blue, emerald green, and warm amber hues captures light beautifully, creating a shimmering effect from every angle. Perfect as a statement décor piece or a meaningful gift, it symbolizes beauty, pride, and prosperity.

Transform your living space with the majestic charm of the Sapphire Peacock Crystal Sculpture, an extraordinary home décor piece that radiates elegance and sophistication. Inspired by the beauty and grace of the peacock, this stunning sculpture is crafted from premium-quality crystal and meticulously finished by skilled artisans to achieve remarkable detail and depth. Standing 31 cm tall, it captures a poised peacock with a gracefully cascading tail, designed to mesmerize viewers from every angle.

The vibrant gradient of hues—emerald green on the body, sapphire blue across the tail, and a warm amber glow at the head—creates a dynamic interplay of colors that reflects and refracts light beautifully. Mounted on a sleek clear crystal base, this sculpture combines artistic finesse with modern design, making it an exquisite statement piece for living rooms, offices, entryways, or display cabinets. Beyond its striking appearance, the peacock has long symbolized beauty, prosperity, and pride—making this sculpture an ideal gift for weddings, anniversaries, or housewarmings, as well as a perfect addition to your own art collection.

This piece is more than décor; it’s a celebration of fine craftsmanship and timeless artistry, designed to bring a touch of luxury to any setting.
